body:
I felt a strange tingle run through my fingertips as I picked up the second key from the communal board. It was slightly tarnished but still gleamed under the sunlight filtering through the window. The shape was familiar—a small oval with a subtle relief pattern around its edge, almost like an ancient map or talisman.

My curiosity peaked, and before I could stop myself, I reached out to touch it gently. As soon as my hand made contact, a sudden chill rippled through me, followed by a momentary blurring vision. When clarity returned, there was a faint whisper in my ear:

"Is this key yours?"

The voice echoed strangely, echoing back from within the confines of the keys itself—its own mind whispered these cryptic words into my thoughts.
